pairs.target: chí ān de dìèr fēngxìn bǐ dìyīfēng duǎn , zhǐbèi què duō huà le yìzhī mùjī .
pairs.english: Chi An's second letter was shorter than the first, but had a wooden clog drawn on its back.
pairs.hanzi: 迟安的第二封信比第一封短，纸背却多画了一只木屐。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shōudào shí , zhèngzài jiāng zuórì chēduì hé guò de wùdiǎn dān fēn hǎo ; nà jǐbǐ yóu chǎngnèi dāngē zàochéng de sǔnshī yǐ dānliè chūlái , huòzhǔ háiyào hé huài cài de shù , bìng méiyǒu yīnwèi liǎngbǎ cài jìn le guō jiù yìqǐ xiāodiào .
pairs.english: When it arrived, Tavi was sorting delay forms checked with the cart team yesterday. Losses caused inside the yard had been listed separately; the owner still needed to check spoiled vegetables, not cancel everything because two bunches had gone into a pot.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维收到时，正在将昨日车队核过的误点单分好；那几笔由场内耽搁造成的损失已单列出来，货主还要核坏菜的数，并没有因为两把菜进了锅就一起销掉。

pairs.target: tā jiāng dānzi yāzhù , xiān kàn xìnfēng .
pairs.english: He pressed the forms down and examined the envelope.
pairs.hanzi: 他将单子压住，先看信封。

pairs.target: sōng dī dōng shì liángmù chǎng de dìzhǐ hái zài , zhǐshì zhèhuí bù jīng xǔ lián zài zhuǎn , zhíjiē jì dào xuégōng , zài yóu xuégōng sònglái fēng zhàn .
pairs.english: The Songdi East Market Liang Timber Yard address remained, but this time it bypassed Xu Lian, going straight to the academy and onward to Wind Trestle.
pairs.hanzi: 松堤东市梁木场的地址还在，只是这回不经许莲再转，直接寄到学宫，再由学宫送来风栈。

pairs.target: chí ān zài kāitóu shuō , qiánjǐrì máng zhe gǎn yìpái ménkuàng , yèlǐ cái yǒu kōngxiǎng , yě zhīxiǎngchū zhèxiē , pà tuō jiǔ le , lián xiǎng chū de zhèdiǎn yě xiě dé bú xiàng yuánlái de le .
pairs.english: Chi An began that he'd spent the past few days rushing a row of door frames, thinking only at night. This was all he'd recalled, and he feared delaying would make even that little unlike the original.
pairs.hanzi: 迟安在开头说，前几日忙着赶一排门框，夜里才有空想，也只想出这些，怕拖久了，连想出的这点也写得不像原来的了。

pairs.target: ā qiǎo hòulái zhù de nà yìjiā , tā zhī jìde yuànlǐ rén jiào yígè nǚrén ā nán .
pairs.english: Of the household Aqiao lived with later, he remembered only people in the courtyard calling a woman A-Nan.
pairs.hanzi: 阿巧后来住的那一家，他只记得院里人叫一个女人阿楠。

pairs.target: shìbushì tā shōuliú le ā qiǎo , tā bùnéng kěndìng ; nǚrén cháng tìrén féngbǔ , ménbiān guà liǎngzhī cháng bùdài , háizi ài shēnshǒu mō dài lǐ yǒu méi suìbù , què huì āi shuō .
pairs.english: He couldn't be certain she had taken Aqiao in. She often mended clothes for people, with two long cloth bags by her door; children liked feeling for scraps inside, and got scolded.
pairs.hanzi: 是不是她收留了阿巧，他不能肯定；女人常替人缝补，门边挂两只长布袋，孩子爱伸手摸袋里有没碎布，却会挨说。

pairs.target: chí ān zìjǐ xiān qù le xǔjiā , líkāi nàtiān bìng méi tóng ā qiǎo shuō shàng huà .
pairs.english: Chi An went to the Xu household first, leaving without a chance to speak to Aqiao.
pairs.hanzi: 迟安自己先去了许家，离开那天并没同阿巧说上话。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yòng zhǐ fù yā zhe ā nán èr zì .
pairs.english: Tavi pressed a fingertip over A-Nan's two characters.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维用指腹压着阿楠二字。

pairs.target: búshì yígè wánzhěng xìngmíng , yě méiyǒu dìfāng kě tóu xìn , shènzhì nà nǚrén shìfǒu tóng ā qiǎo zhù zài yíchù dōu hái shuō bùzhǔn .
pairs.english: No full name, no address for a letter, not even certainty that she and Aqiao had lived together.
pairs.hanzi: 不是一个完整姓名，也没有地方可投信，甚至那女人是否同阿巧住在一处都还说不准。

pairs.target: tā céng yǐwéi wèn dào míngzì , qiántou biàn néng jiēshàng yíshànmén , rújīn zhè liǎnggè zì zhī ràng jiù yuànlǐ duō zhàn le yígè rén .
pairs.english: He had thought a name would lead to a door; these two characters only put another person in the old courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 他曾以为问到名字，前头便能接上一扇门，如今这两个字只让旧院里多站了一个人。

pairs.target: xìn shàng jiēzhe shuō , nàge gèng xiǎo de nǚhái , tā shízài jì bù qǐ hòulái qù le nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: The letter said he truly couldn't remember where the smaller girl had gone.
pairs.hanzi: 信上接着说，那个更小的女孩，他实在记不起后来去了哪里。

pairs.target: dǎo shì lǐng tāmen de nǚrén huílái xiū mùjī shí , hǎoxiàng jiāng dīngtóu àn jìn mù dǐ , pà zhā dào jiǎo .
pairs.english: He did vaguely recall the escort woman pressing nail heads into the clog's wooden sole to protect feet when she returned to repair it.
pairs.hanzi: 倒是领他们的女人回来修木屐时，好像将钉头按进木底，怕扎到脚。

pairs.target: chí ān huà de mùjī cèmiàn wān dé yǒudiǎn guài , zài pángbiān zhùmíng zhè búshì zhào shíwù huà de , bié ná tā qù zhǎo tóngyàng de yìzhī .
pairs.english: His drawn clog had an odd bend, with a note that it wasn't drawn from the object: don't use it to hunt for a matching one.
pairs.hanzi: 迟安画的木屐侧面弯得有点怪，在旁边注明这不是照实物画的，别拿它去找同样的一只。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le hěn jiǔ , jiànjiàn fājué mùjī tóng tā dìyīyǎn xiǎng de bùtóng .
pairs.english: Looking a long time, Tavi gradually saw the clog differently from his first impression.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了很久，渐渐发觉木屐同他第一眼想的不同。

pairs.target: chí ān búshì bǎ yíjiàn jiùwù dìgěi tā , zhǐshì zài zìjǐ hái néng mō dào de dìfāng huàchū yìdiǎn xíngzhuàng .
pairs.english: Chi An wasn't handing him an old object, only tracing a shape where he could still reach.
pairs.hanzi: 迟安不是把一件旧物递给他，只是在自己还能摸到的地方划出一点形状。

pairs.target: nà shíhòu de háizi xián xié chén , huì hù zhe yìshuāng wèibì hǎokàn de xié zǒuláizǒuqù , yě huì láibùjí tóng lìng yígè háizi dàobié .
pairs.english: Those children could dislike heavy shoes yet cherish an ugly pair, or leave without saying goodbye to another child.
pairs.hanzi: 那时候的孩子嫌鞋沉，会护着一双未必好看的鞋走来走去，也会来不及同另一个孩子道别。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xìn fān dào zuìhòu , jiàn chí ān wèn , tǎ wéi huà shuǐbiān fángwū shí , mùtou pào jiǔ le huì buhuì chén ; zìjǐ zuò ménchuāng , zǒng juéde mùtou gāi lí shuǐ yuǎn yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: At the end of the letter, Chi An asked whether timber in the waterside houses Tavi drew would sink after soaking a long time: making doors and windows, he always felt wood should stay farther from water.
pairs.hanzi: 他把信翻到最后，见迟安问，塔维画水边房屋时，木头泡久了会不会沉；自己做门窗，总觉得木头该离水远一点。

pairs.target: zhǐ wěi hái tiān yíjù , bù jí huí , ruò huà dé hǎokàn , xiàcì kě chāo yìxiǎopiàn gěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: A final line said no hurry replying, but if the drawings were attractive, perhaps copy him a little next time.
pairs.hanzi: 纸尾还添一句，不急回，若画得好看，下次可抄一小片给他看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiānqián bēngzhe de jiān mànmàn sōng le .
pairs.english: Tavi's tense shoulders slowly loosened.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先前绷着的肩慢慢松了。

pairs.target: tā yuánlái zhǔnbèi le bànyè jiēzhe wèn de shì , cǐkè fǎn jiāng nà zhāng zhǐ shōuqǐ , cóng shí tīng de cǎotú lǐ zhǎochū yíchù bú dài rénjiā ménpái , yě bú lù sīyòng shuǐlù de xiǎowū cèyǐng .
pairs.english: He put away the half-page of further questions he had prepared, finding instead a little floating house's side view among his Shiting sketches, without household addresses or private water routes.
pairs.hanzi: 他原来准备了半页接着问的事，此刻反将那张纸收起，从石汀的草图里找出一处不带人家门牌、也不露私用水路的小屋侧影。

pairs.target: huà gěi chí ān kàn de nà zhāng méiyǒu bǔ shàng zǒu bùtōng de dī , yě méiyǒu jiāng lǎo shígǒng huà chéng tā xiǎngxiàng lǐ de zhěngzuò qiáo .
pairs.english: His drawing for Chi An didn't complete the inaccessible dyke or turn the old stone half-arch into an imagined whole bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 画给迟安看的那张没有补上走不通的堤，也没有将老石拱画成他想象里的整座桥。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn , tā jiāng chí ān zhè fēngxìn wánzhěng chāo le liǎngfèn .
pairs.english: At dusk he copied Chi An's letter in full twice.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚，他将迟安这封信完整抄了两份。

pairs.target: yífèn jì sè lā , yífèn jì nài lěi , ā nán de míngzì tóng bù kěndìng de jǐchù yíbìng liúxià , méiyòng gèng zhíjiéliǎodàng dehuà tìhuàn .
pairs.english: One copy was for Sela, one for Nerai, retaining both A-Nan's name and every uncertainty without replacing them with more decisive words.
pairs.hanzi: 一份寄瑟拉，一份寄奈蕾，阿楠的名字同不肯定的几处一并留下，没用更直截了当的话替换。

pairs.target: tā yòu gěi chí ān xiě le huíxìn , shuō mùwū bìng búshì dānkào qiángbǎn fú zhe , xiàmiàn lìng yǒu bǎng zài yìqǐ de mùpái , zìjǐ yě zhǐjiàn guò zhè yíchù , biéchù zěnyàng hái bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: He also wrote back to Chi An: the houses didn't float on wallboards alone, but on lashed log rafts underneath. He had only seen this one place, and didn't know about others.
pairs.hanzi: 他又给迟安写了回信，说木屋并不是单靠墙板浮着，下面另有绑在一起的木排，自己也只见过这一处，别处怎样还不知道。

pairs.target: sānfèn gè fù le yóu qián .
pairs.english: He paid postage for all three.
pairs.hanzi: 三份各付了邮钱。

pairs.target: gěi chí ān de nà fēng lǐ , jiù yuàn de wèntí zànshí méi zài tiān , dǎo duō xiě le liǎngháng wūdǐng yǎngjī , chuánshàng gǎn é de shì .
pairs.english: The letter to Chi An held no more old-courtyard questions for now, but two extra lines about roof chickens and a goose herded aboard a boat.
pairs.hanzi: 给迟安的那封里，旧院的问题暂时没再添，倒多写了两行屋顶养鸡、船上赶鹅的事。

pairs.target: bànshì de rén tì tā shōuxìn shí xiào le yíxià , shuō mùgōng yě ài tīng jīyā .
pairs.english: Taking the letters, the clerk smiled: carpenters liked hearing about chickens and ducks too.
pairs.hanzi: 办事的人替他收信时笑了一下，说木工也爱听鸡鸭。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō xìn lǐ shì é , jiǎngwán zìjǐ yě xiào , juéde zhèhuí jiūzhèng rén sìhū méi nàme nán .
pairs.english: He had written geese in the letter, Tavi corrected, laughing himself; correcting someone seemed less difficult this time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说信里是鹅，讲完自己也笑，觉得这回纠正人似乎没那么难。
